description: Ranking of the LLM APIs AI Stupid Level tracks (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM models) by benchmark score, 0-100. Use it to find the best model overall or for coding, reasoning or tool use, to compare models, and to get the model ids the other tools accept. Each row has the score, trend, status, stability and when it was last updated.

period.description: Score window: 24h, 7d or 1m (30-day) averages, or latest (the newest run). Omit it to use the key's default: 24h on a free Data API key, latest on a paid one. latest needs a paid key.

sort_by.description: Which ranking: combined (default, all suites), coding, reasoning, tooling (tool use / agentic tasks), or price (score per list-price dollar).

vendor.description: Only show models from this vendor: openai, anthropic, google, deepseek, kimi or glm.

name: get_leaderboard
title: LLM leaderboard
